about: 27, lives on the Upper East Side, works in marketing. Loves pretty, buzzy, see-and-be-seen places she can dress up for and post about. Dislikes divey, scruffy or hard-to-get-to spots.

places.name: Carbone
places.note: Glamorous, waiters in tuxedos, the spicy rigatoni. Feels like a special night out and you might see someone famous.

places.name: Sadelle's
places.note: Gorgeous brunch, the bagel tower is so photogenic. Bright and buzzy, perfect with friends.

places.name: Bemelmans Bar
places.note: Classic, glamorous hotel bar with live piano. Great martinis, I love getting dressed up for it.

places.name: Ralph's Coffee
places.note: So cute and polished, green and white everything. My go-to coffee stop when I'm shopping.

places.name: Le Bain
places.note: Rooftop at The Standard with amazing views and a fun dance floor. Great for a big night out.

dislikes.name: Roberta's
dislikes.note: Long trek to Bushwick, picnic tables and too hipster. Not my scene at all.

dislikes.name: Sunny's Bar
dislikes.note: Dark and divey, hard to get to and they barely make cocktails.
